'''Garee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Thaereian military]] as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was sent to [[Bayonard]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], as part of a team that included [[Kowen]], [[Yurge]] and [[Jax (Human)|Jax]].
